## Executive Summary
Nikunj Garg is a results-driven Java Backend Developer engineering scalable backend architectures, high-concurrency systems, and real-time distributed services with Java 21, Spring Boot 3, and PostgreSQL. He specializes in eliminating data race conditions and inventory overselling via JPA/Hibernate pessimistic row locking and ACID transactions, architecting low-latency REST APIs, and deploying bidirectional WebSockets (STOMP) with stateless JWT authentication pipelines. BCA student at Shri Guru Ram Rai University (SGRRU, Dehradun), and builder of production-grade systems including DevTinder, LibroSphere, and AgriSathi AI.

## Primary Technical Specializations

- **Databases & Concurrency Control**: PostgreSQL 16, ACID Transactions, Pessimistic / Optimistic Locking, Composite B-Tree Indexing, Schema Design (3NF)

- **DevOps, Cloud & Infrastructure**: Docker, Docker Compose, Render Cloud, Git, GitHub, Maven, Postman, OpenAPI / Swagger 3.0

## Major Projects

### 1. DevTinder — Developer Teammate Matching Platform (Backend Flagship)
- **Overview**: Teammate matchmaking platform originally prototyped during Devlynix Buildathon 2.0 with frontend teammates, then independently evolved and elevated into a production-grade backend service powering a Next.js client.
- **Tech Stack**: Java 21, Spring Boot 3, PostgreSQL 16, WebSockets (STOMP), Spring Security 6 (JWT & Refresh Token Rotation), Docker, Render Cloud.
- **Live Demo**: https://devlynix-frontend12-git-main-hxmblevishus-projects.vercel.app/
- **GitHub Repository**: https://github.com/gargnikunj991-ux/Devlynix-Buildathon-2.0.git
- **Key Capabilities**: Bidirectional STOMP WebSocket broker with delta query synchronization (`?after={id}`) and unread tracking driving message delivery latency under 50ms; Algorithmic Skill Synergy Scoring engine (50–99% compatibility weighting shared stacks, complementary engineering disciplines, and project pitches); stateless Spring Security filters with Refresh Token Rotation, sliding-window IP rate limiting (`RateLimitFilter`), incoming match radar, and queue rewind; Docker containerization with Render Cloud deployment sustaining 99.9% uptime and sub-80ms API response latency.

### 2. LibroSphere — High-Concurrency Asset Lending & Reservation Engine
- **Overview**: High-concurrency asset lending and reservation backend engineered to eliminate race conditions, duplicate allocations, and inventory underflow under peak multi-threaded contention.
- **Tech Stack**: Java 21, Spring Boot 3, PostgreSQL 16, Spring Data JPA, Hibernate ORM, JUnit 5.
- **GitHub Repository**: https://github.com/gargnikunj991-ux/library_spring.git
- **Key Capabilities**: Database row-level pessimistic write locking (`@Lock(LockModeType.PESSIMISTIC_WRITE)` / `SELECT ... FOR UPDATE`) inside atomic `@Transactional` boundaries completely preventing double-checkout TOCTOU anomalies; automated FIFO reservation waitlist queue (`WAITING` -> `NOTIFIED_READY`) with 48-hour pickup reservations; nightly overdue fine reconciliation cron worker (`@Scheduled`) with composite B-Tree indexes slashing query latency from 120ms to under 15ms; comprehensive 64-test automated JUnit 5 suite simulating 50 concurrent checkout worker threads (`CountDownLatch`) validating 100% thread safety and zero oversells.

### 3. AgriSathi AI — Agricultural Intelligence & Decision Platform
- **Overview**: 30-day hackathon agritech backend providing crop health diagnostics, agronomic advisory, and peer-to-peer producer trade.
- **Tech Stack**: Java 21, Spring Boot 3, PostgreSQL, Spring Data JPA, Spring Security, JWT & RBAC, Cloudinary CDN, OpenAPI / Swagger 3.0.
- **Live Demo**: https://agri-sathi-ai-three.vercel.app/
- **GitHub Repository**: https://github.com/gargnikunj991-ux/AgriSathi_AI
- **Key Capabilities**: 25+ modular REST APIs; multipart crop scan ingestion pipeline streaming to Cloudinary CDN and computer vision classification models for real-time disease diagnosis with statistical confidence scores; hyper-local agronomic weather engine, peer-to-peer marketplace, and interactive Swagger 3.0 documentation.
